title: Three Equal-Sum Parts
summary: Return whether the list can be split into three nonempty contiguous parts with equal sums.
statement: Return whether the list can be split into three nonempty contiguous parts with equal sums. Implement `three_equal_sum_parts` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
reference_solution:
def three_equal_sum_parts(nums):
    total = sum(nums)
    if len(nums) < 3 or total % 3: return False
    target = total // 3; running = parts = 0
    for i, value in enumerate(nums[:-1]):
        running += value
        if running == target: parts += 1; running = 0
        if parts == 2 and i < len(nums)-1: return True
    return False
